description.summary: This table details notification requirements regarding fraud or dishonesty by employees under a professional liability insurance policy for investment advisors. It outlines the Assured's obligations upon discovering such acts and the impact on the Insurer's liability.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את דרישות ההודעה בנוגע להונאה או חוסר יושר של עובדים במסגרת פוליסת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית ליועצי השקעות. הפוליסה כוללת סעיפים הנוגעים להודעה על גילוי מעשי הונאה, סיוע לאינסר בהשגת החזר כספי, והשפעת ההודעה על אחריות האינסר. ההודעה צריכה להימסר בכתב בהקדם האפשרי. ביטוח אחריות מקצועית ליועצי השקעות מחייב את המבוטח להודיע על כל מעשה הונאה או חוסר יושר של עובד. במקרה של גילוי מעשה הונאה, המבוטח צריך לספק את כל המידע והסיוע הנדרשים לאינסר כדי לתבוע את העובד המועל או את עיזבונו.
description.column_axis: Details of notification process and consequences
notable_values: Notification Timing: as soon as practical
Insurer Relief: relieved of all liability in respect of any subsequent acts
Indemnification: shall not reduce the Insurer's liability for other employees losses

sketch:
1. Notification
Upon  the  discovery  of  any  act  or  acts  of  fraud  or  dishonesty  by  any  Employee,  or circumstances of which the Assured shall become aware that might give rise to a claim under this Policy, the Assured shall give written notice thereof as soon as practical to the Insurer  and  thereupon  the  Insurer  shall  be  relieved  of  all  liability  in  respect  of  any subsequent acts of such employee, but indemnification for such loss shall not reduce the Insurer's liability for other employees losses under this policy whenever sustained, subject however to the limit of liability as stated in the Schedule.
In the event of discovery by the Assured of any act of fraud or dishonesty giving rise to a claim under this Policy as aforesaid, the Assured shall give all necessary information and assistance to enable the Insurer to sue for and obtain reimbursement, by the defaulting Employee or by his Estate of any money paid or payable by the Insurer hereunder.

טבלה: התראות על הונאה
This table details notification requirements regarding fraud or dishonesty by employees under a professional liability insurance policy for investment advisors. It outlines the Assured's obligations upon discovering such acts and the impact on the Insurer's liability.
ממדים: Notification requirements, Details of notification process and consequences

1. Notification
Upon  the  discovery  of  any  act  or  acts  of  fraud  or  dishonesty  by  any  Employee,  or circumstances of which the Assured shall become aware that might give rise to a claim under this Policy, the Assured shall give written notice thereof as soon as practical to the Insurer  and  thereupon  the  Insurer  shall  be  relieved  of  all  liability  in  respect  of  any subsequent acts of such employee, but indemnification for such loss shall not reduce the Insurer's liability for other employees losses under this policy whenever sustained, subject however to the limit of liability as stated in the Schedule.
In the event of discovery by the Assured of any act of fraud or dishonesty giving rise to a claim under this Policy as aforesaid, the Assured shall give all necessary information and assistance to enable the Insurer to sue for and obtain reimbursement, by the defaulting Employee or by his Estate of any money paid or payable by the Insurer hereunder.
